claims: The Chainsmokers performed a concert at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The Chainsmokers' concert was between the men's Final Four games.
The Chainsmokers' performance occurred between UConn's victory over Illinois and the matchup between Arizona and Michigan.
Some fans complained that the performance delayed the start of the second game until nearly 9:30 p.m. ET.
Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy publicly questioned the decision to hold a live concert in the middle of the game night.
ESPN's Scott Van Pelt publicly questioned the decision to hold a live concert in the middle of the game night.
The Chainsmokers' concert was part of an effort by the NCAA to appeal to more casual fans and enhance the overall entertainment experience of the weekend.
The Chainsmokers' performance was branded as part of "Madness After Dark".
Fans had the opportunity to request tickets to be part of the live audience for the broadcast.
